en: Added `allowedProviders` managed setting to limit which API providers a machine may use (Anthropic API, a custom endpoint, Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex AI, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, or a Cloud gateway)
zh: 新增 `allowedProviders` 管理设置，用于限制某台机器可使用的 API 提供方（Anthropic API、自定义端点、Bedrock、Mantle、Vertex AI、Foundry、Claude Platform on AWS 或 Cloud 网关）
